text:
sasha: Heads-up — CI turned red for my feature branch feature/multitenant after merging main this morning. Fail is on shard 12, test suite tenancy_e2e::tenant_isolation. Can someone help triage?

ci-bot: Build 1955123456 failed on shard 12. Job: integration-e2e (ubuntu-22). Failure: test failures detected. Logs: https://ci.example/redwood/1955123456

ryan: @sasha can you paste the tail of the failing test log here? quick check if it's a flake or deterministic. :eyes:

sasha: pasted below — it's consistently failing locally when I run with --shard=12.
```
=== RUN   TestTenantIsolation
2026-03-15T09:12:34Z | ERROR | tenant test: expected isolation=true got false
stack: runtime.go:234 -> kv_shard.go:112 -> tenant_manager.go:58
assertion failed: leases held across tenants
--- FAIL: TestTenantIsolation
```

amira: That stack looks like the old lock migration code. Did the merge include the kv-lock-migration change from main?

sasha: yes, I pulled main at 2026-03-15T08:55 and resolved a couple conflicts in kv/* — I might have accidentally kept the old lock path in one file.

denise: quick idea: can you run the failing test with RACE=1 and METRICS=1 and post the output? if it's concurrency, race detector will help. Also try `make test-integration PKG=./tenancy -run TestTenantIsolation -shard 12`

sasha: running now, will paste results shortly. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ci-bot: Rerun request queued. Use `/ci rerun 1955123456 --shard=12` to trigger a rerun.

ryan: if it's merge-induced, we should bisect to the last green commit on main vs your branch head. If you want I'll kick off a bisect.

sasha: okay ran with RACE=1, here's the suspicious output:
```
WARNING: data race
Write at 0x00c0001a2b30 by goroutine 48:
  kv.lock.acquire()
  tenant_manager.allocateLease()
Previous read at 0x00c0001a2b30 by goroutine 21:
  tenant_manager.checkLease()
```

amira: yep that's a race. Looks like a missing holder lock around the new eviction path. I saw a subtle rename in your conflict resolution: `holder.mu` -> `holder.lock` in one file but not the other. Might be the root cause.

denise: @sasha can you grep for both `holder.mu` and `holder.lock` in your branch and main to confirm mismatch?

sasha: grep shows mixed usage in `tenant/evict.go` vs `tenant/holder.go`. I must have kept the old symbol in evict.go when resolving. Ugh.

ryan: easy fix: update evict.go to use holder.lock (the canonical name on main). If you want, push a quick hotfix commit and we can re-run CI only for shard 12 to verify.

sasha: pushed fix as commit b7f4c2d — changed holder.mu -> holder.lock and added a small test asserting lock held during eviction. Triggering rerun: `/ci rerun 1955123456 --shard=12`

ci-bot: Rerun started for build 1955123456 (rerun:1) on shard 12.

ryan: nice. if that passes, we can merge. if it flakes, we'll do a bisection to find the offending merge commit.

denise: also please add a one-line note in the PR description about the symbol rename conflict so reviewers check for similar cases. :memo:

sasha: will do. thanks all. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Build 1955123456 (rerun:1) completed — shard 12: SUCCESS. All integration tests for shard 12 passed.

ryan: great — marking this thread resolved. I'll do a quick post-merge check on production-like staging later today to be safe.

sasha: thanks everyone for the quick triage and help.
